title: Valid Parentheses
statement:
Given a string `s` containing only the characters `(`, `)`, `{`, `}`, `[` and `]`, return `true` if the brackets are valid.

Brackets are valid when every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket, in the correct order, and every closing bracket has an opening one.

keyPoints.text: Uses a stack of open brackets and pops on each closing bracket
Rejects a closing bracket when the stack is empty or its top is a different type
Rejects input that leaves unclosed brackets on the stack at the end

tests.name: Example 2
tests.explanation: The bracket opened with ( is closed with ].
